goals.label: Choose the right university program
goals.title: Research 3 programs
goals.objective: Compare three university programs for this path: admission requirements, co-op options and first-year courses.
goals.learn: Knowing your real options makes application decisions far less stressful.

goals.label: Land a co-op, internship or summer job
goals.title: Get real experience
goals.objective: Apply to three co-op, internship, volunteer or summer roles connected to this path.
goals.learn: Experience shows you what the work is really like, and it stands out on applications.

goals.label: Build a portfolio of projects
goals.title: Portfolio piece
goals.objective: Finish one project for this path and write a short page about what you made and learned.
goals.learn: A portfolio proves your skills in a way grades can't.

goals.label: Earn a certificate or credential
goals.title: Earn a credential
goals.objective: Complete a free online certificate or badge connected to this path.
goals.learn: Credentials show initiative and give you a structured way to learn.

goals.label: Meet people working in the field
goals.title: Talk to a professional
goals.objective: Have a 15-minute conversation with someone working in this field and write down three things you learned.
goals.learn: One conversation can teach you more about a career than hours of reading.

goals.label: Raise my grades in key courses
goals.title: Level up a key course
goals.objective: Pick the course that matters most for this path, set a grade goal, and follow a weekly study plan for a month.
goals.learn: Strong grades in the right courses keep more doors open.

goals.label: Start a project, club or business
goals.title: Launch something
goals.objective: Start a small project, club or venture related to this path and keep it running for a month.
goals.learn: Running something yourself builds leadership and shows real drive.

goals.label: Give back to my community
goals.title: Make an impact
goals.objective: Use a skill from this path to help a local group, club or person.
goals.learn: Helping others with your skills is one of the best ways to find meaning in a career.
